slot: Hero / Origin background — full-bleed behind the name. Keep right 2/3 dark for text.

IMPORTANT: leave the entire right two-thirds of the frame as calm negative space and shadow so large display text can sit over it; keep the exposure low-key and moody, no bright background, no window blowing out. editorial industrial still-life photography in the spirit of Todd Hido and early-morning factory reportage, calm, patient, anticipatory mood, no people, no text, no logos, no UI elements, no sparkles, no glowing dust, no lens flare.

slot: Build section — feature still or card image for the CNC project.
prompt: build-cut :: real high-speed macro photograph, the moment of cutting. extreme close-up of a carbide end mill biting into a block of brushed aluminum on a CNC router bed, three-quarter angle. a tight spray of hot metal chips arcs off the cutter, each chip a tiny spark of burnt-orange (#e2531d) and bone-white (#ece4d6) heat, frozen mid-air. the aluminum is cool brushed steel-grey (#88a0ab), the cutter and collet a dark machined silhouette, the background falls to espresso-black (#16130e) bokeh. one hard warm key light rakes from the right to catch the chip spray; everything else is warm-ink shadow. shot on Canon R5 with a 100mm macro, f/4, 1/2000s, ISO 400, very shallow depth of field with only the cutting edge tack-sharp, real photograph not CGI, natural grain, faint real motion blur on the flying chips. mood: precise, kinetic, hot. macro industrial photography, no people, no text, no logos, no UI, no CGI sheen, no exaggerated cartoon sparks, no lens flare.

slot: Simulate section — drop into a sim card viz, or use as the section background. Pairs with the Double Pendulum.
prompt: simulate-trace :: real long-exposure light-painting photograph on a black studio background, physics made visible. a single LED tracer mounted on the tip of a swinging double pendulum draws ONE continuous chaotic looping ribbon of burnt-orange (#e2531d) light against a seamless warm-ink (#16130e) backdrop. the orange trail is a thin, sharply-in-focus atmospheric line, brightest where the pendulum moved slowly and faintly motion-blurred where it whipped fast, knotting over itself in an elegant unrepeatable tangle in the centre of the frame. one faint secondary trail in muted steel-blue (#88a0ab) ghosts behind it from a slower swing. no apparatus visible, only the light. shot on Nikon Z8, 50mm, f/8, ISO 64, 12 second exposure in a blacked-out room, real photograph not CGI, natural sensor noise, true light falloff. mood: scientific, meditative, beautiful. in the spirit of long-exposure light-painting and oscilloscope photography, perfectly centered with generous black negative space around the trail, no text, no logos, no UI, no glowing dust, no extra sparkles, no lens flare.

slot: Deploy section — feature still beside the Raymond role copy.
